verdict.rationale: Hardware media engines and driver certification are a fair axis for any GPU, but the evidence pack never mentions AV1/HEVC encode/decode engines, creator-app acceleration, or ISV-certified professional drivers for the H200. The 'NVIDIA-Certified Systems' mention concerns server platform certification, an adjacent feature rather than ISV creator-app driver certification.

support.subject: As a creator, hardware media engines and creator-app acceleration are documented — AV1/HEVC encoders, and professional or ISV-certified driver support where the vendor claims it
